mapper.select: select id, sku_code, sku_name, spec_json, sale_price, original_price, stock, locked_stock, greatest(stock - locked_stock, 0) as available_stock, status from product_sku where product_id = #{productId} and is_deleted = 0 order by status desc, sort desc, id asc
select * from product_sku where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0 limit 1
